description: A black athletic shoe sits on a green-covered table in front of you, with its laces spread over the top. Both hands move in to grasp the lace loops near the tongue as a two-hand object, then the hands pull outward to undo the bow and loosen the laces; the right hand lifts and flicks a lace end up and to the right while the left hand relaxes and lets its lace fall back onto the shoe.
